arw-monotonicity.title: Directed three-cycle killed-return order
arw-monotonicity.scope: Six polynomial identities reconstructed from 2,232 Bernstein coefficients for the directed three-cycle killed-return kernel, plus an independent rational kernel calculation and cylinder obstruction.
arw-monotonicity.limits: Does not certify the general add-one conjecture, entrance-law order or an all-length theorem; this is not a Lean proof.

combinatorial-processes.title: Some combinatorial processes
combinatorial-processes.kind: Mixed exact finite checks, symbolic identities and numerical validation
combinatorial-processes.scope: Finite sock, seating, coupon, permutation, arrow and Egyptian-fraction enumerations; symbolic identities; numerical integrals and asymptotic diagnostics; saved certificate and figure provenance hashes.
combinatorial-processes.limits: Individual checks use different arithmetic. Passing them does not establish all asymptotic statements in the notes, and this is not a Lean proof.

word-potentials.kind: Mixed symbolic identities and floating-point validation
word-potentials.scope: Default word-frequency, overlap, conjugacy and crossing checks in the supplied script.
word-potentials.limits: The optional --scan modes are not part of the default suite; numerical scans are not universal proofs.

higher-dimensional-sfts.scope: 32,768 local contexts, the explicit simultaneous-swap example, the replacement obstruction and finite agreement-class graphs (Theorem 5.1 example and Corollary 6.2).
higher-dimensional-sfts.limits: This selected export does not certify the entropy comparisons over all rectangular supports.

arw-negative-association.scope: Recheck all 7,656 event-gap polynomials in 44 saved four-site laws and finite complete-graph deletion-source identities.
arw-negative-association.limits: The saved-law check does not recompute absorption; four_site.py provides the longer reconstruction. The analytic theorems are supported by the selected technical proofs, not by these finite tests alone.

counting-clusters.kind: Exact finite enumeration and polynomial identities
counting-clusters.scope: Small-strip slopes, all-length formula certificates, Euler identities and free/wired comparisons.
counting-clusters.limits: The width-17 enclosure has a separate multi-GB verification command; it is not rerun by this default suite.

independent-coupons.scope: Truncated sums for the stretched-exponential example.
independent-coupons.limits: These sums corroborate scales and are not certified error bounds or proofs.

sandpile.limits: This checks an auxiliary calculation, not the reader article’s depletion or scaling theorems.

balloons.scope: Rigorous evaluation of the early-label cutoff budget.
balloons.limits: The cutoff certificate does not enclose the survivor-noise constant. Separate interval programs evaluate the bounds and matching coefficient; the Lean package covers specified finite statements only.

lean_projects.scope: Finite process through Stable.lean; asymptotic results not formalized
